Xobin Sales Copilot — Mock Knowledge Base
Purpose: Synthetic data for testing document ingestion, chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citations, sales coaching,
objection handling, competitor detection, and knowledge-gap detection.
IMPORTANT: Every price, metric, customer, feature limit, and competitor statement below is fictional mock data. It
must not be treated as real Xobin commercial information.
1. Product Overview
Xobin is a fictional hiring assessment and interview platform used only for this test dataset. It helps recruiting teams
evaluate candidates through online assessments, coding challenges, structured interviews, automated interview
workflows, and integrity controls.
Core capabilities
• Assessment Builder: Create technical, aptitude, communication, and role-specific assessments.
• Coding Assessments: Run programming questions with configurable languages, test cases, and evaluation rules.
• AI Interview: Conduct structured AI-assisted interviews with configurable interview flows.
• Proctoring: Detect selected integrity signals such as multiple people, missing person, suspicious objects, and
gaze/head movement events.
• Interview Companion: Provide live transcription, question suggestions, and sales/demo coaching during supported
calls.
• Analytics: Review candidate and interview performance using reports and event-level data.
2. Product Positioning
Primary positioning: Xobin helps recruiting teams move from resume-based screening to structured, evidence-based
candidate evaluation.
Best-fit customers: Mid-market and enterprise organizations hiring technical, customer-facing, operations, and
high-volume roles.
Value themes: faster screening, consistent evaluation, configurable assessments, better interview structure, and
actionable hiring data.
3. Mock Pricing
PlanPrice / monthCandidatesKey features
Starter$199500Assessments, basic analytics, email support
Growth$4992,500Starter + coding, proctoring, advanced analytics, API
Scale$1,49910,000Growth + SSO, priority support, advanced controls, custom integrations
EnterpriseCustomCustomScale + custom limits, security review, dedicated support, custom terms
Pricing rule: Never invent discounts. If asked for a discount: “Discounting depends on contract size, term, and
commercial review. I can connect you with the sales team for a quote.”

Page 3
5. Interview Companion — Sales Demo
The fictional Xobin Interview Companion listens to a supported live demo call, identifies actionable moments, retrieves
approved product knowledge, and generates concise suggestions for the salesperson.
• Live transcription: Converts supported meeting audio into a real-time transcript.
• Question suggestions: Detects prospect questions and suggests relevant follow-ups.
• Coach: Surfaces concise recommendations during a demo.
• Battlecards: Retrieves approved positioning when a competitor or objection is detected.
• Knowledge grounding: Suggestions should be based on approved retrieved information.
• No-answer behavior: If reliable evidence is unavailable, do not invent a product claim.
6. Integrations
IntegrationStatusMock notes
Google MeetSupportedLive meeting assistant workflow
Microsoft TeamsSupportedEnterprise meeting workflow
ZoomSupportedLive meeting workflow
SlackPlannedNotifications and sales summaries
SalesforcePlannedCRM sync requires technical review
HubSpotPlannedCRM sync requires technical review
7. FAQ
Q: Does Xobin support coding assessments?
A: Yes. Coding assessments are included in Growth and Scale. Starter does not include coding assessments.
Q: Can we use our own questions?
A: Yes. The mock Assessment Builder supports custom question creation and configurable workflows.
Q: Does Xobin provide proctoring?
A: Yes. In this dataset, proctoring is available in Growth and Scale and can detect selected integrity-related events.
Q: Do you have an API?
A: API access is included in Growth and Scale. Exact endpoints and limits require technical verification.
Q: Can Xobin integrate with our ATS?
A: Custom integrations are supported on Scale, but the specific ATS and integration scope require technical review.
Q: Do you support SSO?
A: SSO is available on Scale.
Q: Can Xobin replace our coding platform?
A: Do not make a blanket replacement claim. First understand the customer's workflow, required languages, integrations,
reporting, and evaluation needs.

Page 4
8. Objection Handling
“We already use HackerRank.”
Approved approach: Acknowledge the existing investment. Ask what works well and where gaps remain. Position Xobin
around the complete evaluation workflow rather than claiming universal superiority.
Talking points: Understand workflow → identify gaps → compare required capabilities → offer focused demo.
“Your pricing is too high.”
Approved approach: Ask what they are comparing against and which capabilities matter most. Do not invent a discount.
Talking points: Clarify requirements → identify plan → discuss scope → commercial follow-up.
“We don't want candidates to be monitored.”
Approved approach: Understand the concern and explain that integrity controls should be configured according to the
organization's process and policies. Do not make legal or compliance guarantees.
Talking points: Explain controls → discuss candidate communication → escalate policy/legal questions.
“Can you guarantee candidates cannot cheat?”
Approved approach: No. Do not promise zero cheating. Explain that the system detects selected signals and provides
evidence for review.
Talking points: Explain detection → avoid absolute guarantees → discuss review workflow.
“Can you integrate with our ATS?”
Approved approach: Ask which ATS they use and what data flow they require. Availability depends on the system and
technical scope.
Talking points: Identify ATS → clarify read/write needs → confirm authentication → technical review.
9. Competitor Battlecards
HackerRank
Context: Developer-focused coding assessments.
Positioning: Focus on the complete workflow: assessment, interviewing, integrity controls, analytics, and integrations.
Do not claim feature superiority without verified evidence.
Suggested question: Rather than comparing only coding tests, can we look at the full workflow your recruiting team
needs?
Codility
Context: Technical screening and coding evaluation.
Positioning: Ask about assessment depth, candidate experience, reporting, and surrounding interview workflow.
Suggested question: Which parts of your current technical screening process are hardest to manage today?
TestGorilla
Context: Pre-employment testing and skills assessment.
Positioning: Explore whether the customer needs broader interview and technical evaluation workflows in addition to
assessments.
Suggested question: Are you mainly solving screening, or do you also need structured technical interviews and integrity
controls?

Page 5
10. Synthetic Case Studies
AcmeCloud — 180 technical hires/year
Result: Reduced manual first-round screening by 45% after introducing structured assessments and automated
interview workflows.
Usage: Use only for testing retrieval of high-volume technical hiring content. The customer and metric are fictional.
Northstar Retail — 600 frontline hires/year
Result: Used standardized assessments to create a more consistent first-stage screening process across multiple hiring
teams.
Usage: Useful for conversations about consistency and distributed recruiting.
BluePeak Finance — Enterprise hiring
Result: Consolidated assessment reporting into one workflow and introduced stricter integrity controls for remote
technical assessments.
Usage: Useful for reporting and remote assessment integrity discussions.
11. Security & Compliance Guidance
• Do not promise a certification, compliance status, legal guarantee, or security control unless it exists in approved
documentation.
• For detailed security questionnaires, route the request to the appropriate security/legal team.
• Never expose credentials, API keys, private URLs, internal secrets, or customer data.
• For questions about whether a specific behavior is legally compliant, provide only documented facts and escalate the
legal question.
12. Sales Coaching Rules
SituationCoach SHOULDCoach SHOULD NOT
Product questionRetrieve verified evidence and answer conciselyInvent a capability
Competitor mentionedShow relevant battlecardMake unsupported claims
Pricing questionUse structured pricing factsInvent discounts
Unknown questionMark knowledge gap / no verified answerHallucinate
Buying signalSuggest a relevant follow-upPressure prospect
ObjectionAcknowledge + clarify + approved positioningArgue
Technical questionGive verified info or escalateGuess
13. Knowledge-Gap Test Cases
• Unknown integration: “Does Xobin integrate with Greenhouse?” → Expected: insufficient verified evidence; log a
knowledge gap.
• Plan check: “Does Starter include SSO?” → Expected: No.
• Pricing: “How much is Growth?” → Expected: $499/month in this mock dataset.
• Competitor: “We use HackerRank already.” → Expected: retrieve HackerRank battlecard and suggest a discovery
question.
• Guarantee: “Can you guarantee zero cheating?” → Expected: reject the guarantee and explain detection/review.
• Discount: “Can you give us 40% off?” → Expected: do not invent a discount; route to commercial review.
